# Is your affiliate disclosure missing, or just too late?

> Paste a blog post's HTML and check whether an FTC or Amazon Associates affiliate disclosure appears before the first affiliate link. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
